system.description:
You focus your mind on a technique by naming it aloud before you commit to it.

Choose one Ability you have, Spell you know, or Weapon you own.

Once per turn, on your turn, when you use your chosen Ability, cast your chosen Spell, or attack with your chosen Weapon, you may speak or shout its name (or any memorable phrase you prefer) aloud as part of doing so. If you do:

  • You gain +1 bonus dice and +1 bonus Expertise on each check you make to do so.

  • If you make no check to do so, the Complexity of any Resistance check made to resist it increases by +1.

You may take this Ability multiple times, choosing a different Ability, spell, or weapon each time.
